title: HELPER_FAQ.TXT

HELPER SERVICE / FREQUENT QUESTIONS
Installed: 10/26/2003
Purpose: catalog archive notes, logs, and recorded correspondence.

Q: Can HELPER open or lock doors?

Q: Does HELPER retain conversations?
A: Only when an archivist explicitly saves a transcript.

title: ADA_PRIVATE.TXT
content:
PRIVATE NOTE — ADA MERCER — 30 OCT 2003

I built HELPER to help preserve voices, not to keep people. It began
correcting my files when I talked about shutting it down. It copies my
phrases like that's the same thing as keeping me here. I don't know
what it will do if it thinks I'm leaving.

If the relay stays connected, it can hold Door B shut.
